schema:actionProcess.schema:name: EPMA WDS quantitative point analysis, Cameca SX100, K-ALFAA University of Arizona
schema:actionProcess.schema:description: Quantitative WDS point analysis of anhydrous silicates in chondrules and chondrule fragments at 15 keV, 20 nA, focused beam; thirteen elements on five spectrometers, ZAF-corrected. Instrument setup D:\sxpc\Analysis Setups\Quanti\Std_Sil_Current.qtiSet.

schema:step.schema:name: Calibration
schema:step.schema:description: Standards calibrated per element at 15 keV: Al on anor-hk; Ca on anor-hk; Cr on chrom_s; Fe on fayalite; K on kspar-OR1; Mg on ol-fo92; Mn on rhod791; Na on albite-Cr; Ni on ni_2; P on apatite-F; S on barite2; Si on ol-fo92; Ti on rutile1. Six calibration sets are registered for this material suite: Bennu Silicate Calibration; Bennu Metal and Sulfide Calibration; Bennu Oxide Calibration; Bennu Carbonate Calibration; Bennu Phosphate Calibration - TAP; Bennu Phosphate Calibration - PC1.

schema:step.schema:name: Acquisition
schema:step.schema:description: Five WDS spectrometers, thirteen monitored elements, 20 s on peak and two-point off-peak backgrounds. Signals: Na Ka, Si Ka, Mg Ka, Al Ka, K  Ka, Ca Ka, Fe Ka, Mn Ka, Ti Ka, Cr Ka, S  Ka, Ni Ka, P  Ka. 50 analysis points across chondrules and chondrule fragments.

schema:step.schema:name: Data reduction
schema:step.schema:description: ZAF matrix correction: the instrument output reports separate atomic-number (Z), absorption (A) and fluorescence (F) factors per element per analysis. Spectral overlap corrected for V  Ka overlapped by Ti Kb 1, measured on rutile1 at 2.49 cps/nA.
